ideas.title: Minnesota's Human Services Overhaul: A Path to Transparency?
ideas.description: Investigate Governor Tim Walz's plan to transform Minnesota's human services system. Analyze the proposal's potential impact on fraud prevention and the challenges ahead.
ideas.angle: In-depth analysis of the proposal and its implications
questions: What are the key components of the proposal?
How will the overhaul impact current services?
What measures are in place to prevent future fraud?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover the extent of fraud within Minnesota's human services and the effectiveness of the proposed reforms.

ideas.title: The Scale of Healthcare Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the prevalence and financial impact of healthcare fraud in Minnesota. Examine current investigations and the role of state and federal agencies.
ideas.angle: Quantifying the problem and exploring solutions
questions: What is the estimated cost of healthcare fraud in Minnesota?
Which agencies are involved in investigations?
What are the most common types of healthcare fraud?
ideas.insight: This story could shed light on the scope of healthcare fraud and the challenges of combating it.
